title: Micro-rotation onboarding playlist & interview evidence journal
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, playbook-style playlist for micro-rotation hires (4–12 week rotations and short-term contractors), and a lightweight interview evidence journal to capture signals useful for rapid match, onboarding prioritization, and 60-day ramp evaluation.

Context / why this exists:
- We run many 6–12 week micro-rotations for cross-functional discovery, platform embed trials, and contractor pilots.
- Current onboarding is too heavyweight; rotations need an "essential-first" approach so hires contribute quickly and hand off cleanly.
- Interview notes are often scattered; this journal centralizes critical evidence to inform mentor pairing and day-1 priorities.

Scope & audience:
- People Ops + Hiring Manager + Host Team + Mentor pool.
- Applies to: contractor pilots, rotational ICs, internal cross-pod rotations.
- Not for full-time senior hires (use standard 90–120 day playbook).

Quick definitions:
- Rotation: 4–12 week assignment with a clear deliverable/learning objective.
- Host Team: team receiving the rotation hire.
- Mentor: day-to-day technical buddy (can be fractional).
- Evidence Journal: concise capture of interview signals mapped to onboarding tasks.

Hiring / interview rubric (compact):
- Core criteria (score 1–4 each):
  - Role-Adjacency (domain fit, baseline 3+ for short pilots)
  - Practical Impact (past small-scope wins, shipping experiments)
  - Communication (async docs + clear tradeoffs)
  - Learning Agility (quick ramp examples)
  - Autonomy (ability to unblock without heavy handholding)

- Pass threshold for rotation: total >= 14/20 OR manager signoff with 12/20 + strong compensating evidence.
- Evidence journal fields (fill during interview): top-3 strengths, top-3 risks, 1-line recommended day-1 task, suggested mentor type, any blocking security/compliance needs.

Hiring timeline (target):
- Day -14: JD posted, hiring manager + people ops agree success criteria and day-1 must-have tasks.
- Day -7: Screening completed, short take-home or whiteboard removed by default (preference for work sample or past artifact review).
- Day 0: offer signed, onboarding packet sent (1-pager + access checklist).

Day-1 must-haves (essential-first):
- Account & repo access verified (SRE pass/fail checklist).
- Short "orientation doc" from Host Team: context, 3 priorities, team calendar, who-to-ask.
- Assigned mentor and first sync scheduled (30m).
- 2–3 small, production-adjacent starter tasks with clear acceptance criteria (not docs only).

60-day playlist (week-by-week highlights):
- Week 1 (setup + small deliverable): clone repo, local dev flow, run tests, complete starter task A, 1:1 with mentor twice.
- Week 2 (contribute + feedback): submit first PR, shadow code review, doc short postmortem of learning.
- Weeks 3–4 (expanded scope): own mini-slice feature or bug triage run, present short demo to Host Team.
- Month 2 (handoff + outcome): iterate on deliverable, compile handoff doc, measure outcome vs success criteria, decide extension/transition.

Mentor rotation schedule (template):
- Week 0 prep: mentor reads evidence journal and day-1 tasks.
- Weeks 1–2: mentor 3x/wk short standups (15m) + async notes.
- Weeks 3–4: mentor 2x/wk, shift to weekly 1:1.
- Week 5+: mentor moves to weekly check-ins + final handoff planning.

Feedback & evaluation cadence:
- Weekly 1–2 line async status updates (host team) into People Ops thread.
- Formal 30-day checkpoint: manager + mentor + POps (15–30m) — update journal, red/amber/green status.
- Formal 60-day review: deliverable review, handoff quality, recommendation (extend / convert / offboard).

Offboarding & knowledge capture (end of rotation):
- Final deliverable checklist (code merged, infra cleaned, runbooks updated).
- Handoff doc template: context, decisions, follow-ups (assign owners).
- Archive evidence journal and PR links into host repo under /onboarding/rotations/NAME.

Rapid templates (copy-paste):
- Day-1 Orientation doc (1-paragraph team mission, 3 priorities, calendar + escalation contact)
- 30-day checkpoint note (status, blockers, help requests, quick wins)
- Handoff one-pager (what was built, how to run, next 3 steps)

Risk mitigation & escalation: short notes
- Access delays = shift starter tasks to documentation + product review but keep first-week goal to deliver something visible.
- Mentor bandwidth limited = assign rotating backstop mentor and clear async QA windows.
- Low signal at 14 days = run focused practical assessment (2–3hr contrived task) before continuing.

People Ops TODOs (for each rotation):
- Create offer with clear end-date and extension clause.
- Ensure manager completes evidence journal before day 0.
- Reserve mentor time on calendar and confirm host team's starter tasks.
- Add rotation to central tracker (jira/hire board + confluence index).

Notes to self / open questions (working):
- Determine if rotation candidates should have a standardized short take-home (15–90m) — pros/cons documented.
- Build small reporting dashboard for rotation outcomes (time-to-first-merge, deliverable completeness).

Related links & refs:
- confluence:ONBOARDING-rotations-2025 (master index)
- jira:HIRE-7890 (current open contract cohort)
- github:pr/456 (example rotation deliverable)

Quick checklist (copyable):
- [ ] Evidence journal completed at offer stage
- [ ] Mentor assigned and calendar invites sent
- [ ] Day-1 orientation doc created by Host Team
- [ ] Starter task A assigned with acceptance criteria
- [ ] 30-day checkpoint scheduled
- [ ] 60-day review scheduled
- [ ] Handoff doc template ready before final week

Endnotes: lightweight, repeatable, and designed to bias toward shipping small measurable outcomes while preserving learning and knowledge transfer. Keep this doc living — tag additions with date and minimal rationale.
